title: mzLab: a browser-based teaching tool for LC-MS data analysis and the search for transformation products
description: mzLab is a free teaching program that runs entirely in the web browser. Students explore real LC-MS data from a triple quadrupole at unit resolution, and high-resolution Orbitrap and Q-TOF files, to search for the transformation products of a pollutant degraded by photocatalysis. The program shows the data and does not give the answers. It includes theory chapters and practice games (Italian), a chemical structure editor, and requires no installation, no account and no tracking: files never leave the user's computer.
